newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INSIGHT - CHARTISTS BULLISH ON BEL-20 INDEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - CHARTISTS BULLISH ON BEL-20 INDEX.

text.p: The Brussels bourse's Bel-20
share index should continue last week's bull run, Belgian
technical analysts said on Monday.
But they added that resistance at the 1,900 level might be
hard to break, especially considering the overbought condition
of the market.
On Monday at midday, the index was down 8.52 points at
1,860.96. On Friday the Bel-20 closed at 1,869.48, up sharply
from 1,823.69 on Friday November 8.

ECOFIS - Resistance at 1,824 was taken out on Tuesday and
resistance at 1,830 on Wednesday. In addition, the two last
daily observations of last week were preceded by windows or
gaps. All of these amount to bullish factors. (Frank Boll)
PARIBAS - The Bel-20 not only hit our medium-term target at
1,850, but also managed to close after a very strong rally at a
high of 1,870. This strong performance indicates that the bull
run may not be over yet. Technically, however, the hourly charts
are pointing towards an overbought market and indicate a
possible correction towards 1,850. On the upside the index will
meet very strong resistance in the 1,880 to 1,900 zone and we do
not expect this resistance to be broken yet. (Philip Tortelboom)
